facts.text: Deosai National Park can be accessed from two main routes: Skardu north and Astore west.
A 4WD vehicle is recommended for either route, especially in early summer when snowmelt can affect paths.
From Skardu, the route is uninhabited until Chilam Chowki, where a small summer hotel offers tea and yogurt.
Between November and May the area of Deosai is snow bound.
facts.quote: Between the months of November and May the area of Deosai is snow bound.

facts.text: Most visitors come to the lake in the summer, between June and early September.
The Balti people call it 'Ghbiarsa', meaning 'summer's place', because it is only accessible in the summer.
The Deosai Plains are situated at an average elevation of 4,114 metres (13,497 ft) above sea level.
Sheosar Lake is located at an elevation of 4,250 metres (13,940 ft).
The fee for visiting Deosai National Park for local tourists is Rs:500 Pkr per person.
Consider a guided tour for added safety and a richer experience.
facts.quote: Consider a guided tour for added safety
